title: Titanium Wheel Spoke
alloyReason: Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V (UNS R56400) is specified for Titanium Wheel Spoke because its 900+ MPa tensile strength allows thin-wall tube shaping without buckling, critical for lightweight frame and component structures. The alpha-beta microstructure delivers 45% higher specific strength than 4140 chromoly steel, translating directly to gram-level weight savings where it matters. Its high-cycle fatigue endurance limit (>500 MPa @10^7 cycles) matches the pedaling load spectrum of Aerodynamic bladed wheel spoke. This rationale is driven by aerodynamic bladed wheel spoke and service environment demands.
process: CNC turning Swiss-type for wheel hardware geometry
Thread rolling DIN 13-1 6g with SPC sampling
Go/No-Go ring gauging with SPC sampling
surfaceTreatment: Bead blasting 120 grit Al2O3 for matte finish Ra 1.6-3.2um followed by passive oxide stabilization in DI water — tailored for aerodynamic bladed wheel application
commonFailures: Bearing race brinelling from over-torque - avoided by torque-limiting press-fit tool with ±2% accuracy — critical for aerodynamic bladed wheel performance

faq.q: Does Titanium Wheel Spoke require special assembly or anti-seize?
faq.a: Yes. Titanium-to-titanium threaded interfaces on Titanium Wheel Spoke are susceptible to galling (cold welding) during assembly. Application of MoS₂ or copper-based anti-seize compound to all threaded contact surfaces is mandatory. Lubricated installation torque values are typically 15-20% lower than dry values. Thread engagement should not exceed 3× thread diameter.

faq.q: What is the typical lead time for Titanium Wheel Spoke orders?
faq.a: Standard lead time for Titanium Wheel Spoke is 15-25 business days depending on quantity and complexity. Rush orders (3-5 working days) are available for prototype evaluation. Sample evaluation (1-5 units) can be expedited to 5-7 business days. Volume pricing is available for production quantities above 100 units.

faq.q: What material certifications are provided with Titanium Wheel Spoke?
faq.a: Each Titanium Wheel Spoke shipment includes EN 10204 Type 3.1 mill test certificate with chemical analysis, mechanical properties, and heat identification. Dimensional inspection reports and Certificate of Conformance (CoC) are standard. First Article Inspection Reports (FAIR) per AS9102 are available on request for aerodynamic bladed wheel.
